## Objective

Describe the desired capability and the affected modules under `src/`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Configuration keys are validated by `ConfigSchema` in `src/config/ConfigSchema.ts`
- [ ] Changes pass `npm run format:check`, `npm run lint`, and `npm run build`
- [ ] Documentation in `docs/` is updated to reflect the new behavior
